transcript.t: Look up at the sky at night, and you may see a small light moving slowly. It might be a satellite. There are thousands of satellites circling the Earth.
Some of them take pictures of clouds, so weather reports can tell us when a storm is coming. Others help our phones find the way on a map. Some even carry TV programmes across the world.
A rocket carries a satellite into space, and it can work there for many years. Life without satellites would be much less convenient.
